Sets a pixel of a buffer to a color given as an ARGB number, for example `(red Shl 16) Or (green Shl 8) Or blue`. This works without a lock, but each call is slow. Lock the buffer and use [WritePixelFast](WritePixelFast) for many pixels.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
For i = 0 To 255
	WritePixel 32 + i, 120, (i Shl 16) Or ((255 - i) Shl 8) Or 128
Next
Flip
WaitKey
```
@param x       Horizontal position of the pixel.
@param y       Vertical position of the pixel.
@param argb    The color. Only the lower 24 bits are used; the pixel is always opaque.
@param buffer  The buffer to write to. Defaults to the current buffer.
@gap A position outside of the buffer is ignored.
@gap A buffer that [Graphics3D](Graphics3D) made with the depth 30 takes A2R10G10B10 (2 bits of alpha on top, then 10 for each of red, green and blue), and one with 64 takes ARGB with 8 bits for each, which is widened. [WritePixel64](WritePixel64) takes all 64 bits. See [Color depth](Color-Depth).
